name: craft-vscode-workspace
description: Shared sources, independent Craft extensions, and an optional suite pack.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/unit/*.test.js scripts/test-font-assets.mjs scripts/test-upstream-patches.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs integration
scripts.test:rendering: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs rendering
scripts.test:editing: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs editing
scripts.test:office: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs office
scripts.test:theme: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs theme
scripts.test:graphics: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs graphics
scripts.test:languages: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs languages
scripts.test:platform: npm run compile && node scripts/test-extensions.cjs platform
